summary: Board state remains mutable after game is won in BoardComponent.makeMove
body:
In BoardComponent, players can continue making moves on empty squares even after a winner has been determined, causing post-game board mutation and invalid turn state.

Affected service: tictactoe-app
Affected component: src/app/board/board.component.ts — makeMove(idx)
Repository: https://github.com/daryllrebeiro/tictactoe

Stack trace / logs:
2026-08-31T12:00:00Z INFO game.board: Move placed at index 2 by Player X
2026-08-31T12:00:00Z INFO game.evaluator: Winning line detected [0, 1, 2] for Player X
2026-08-31T12:00:02Z WARN game.board: Subsequent move registered at index 8 after winner declared

Expected behavior: Once a winner is declared, subsequent clicks on empty squares must be ignored until 'Start new Game' is clicked.
Actual behavior: Index 8 is filled with 'O', xIsNext toggles, and moves continue to register on the board.
steps: X plays index 2 (top-right) -> Player X wins with top row [0, 1, 2].
Click any remaining unplayed square (e.g. index 8).
impact: Game state corruption and invalid winner preservation after match completion.
